simple.meaning: אוּץ (ʼûwts) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to press ; (by implication) to be close , hurry , withdraw.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 10 times in Genesis, Exodus, Joshua, Proverbs, Isaiah, and 1 more, beginning at Genesis 19:15. The surrounding contexts include family line, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אוּץ (H213) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אוּץ (ʼûwts) / H213 is traced through Genesis 19:15, Exodus 5:13, Joshua 10:13, Joshua 17:15 with source-language evidence and verse context.

timeline.evidenceText: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”
The taskmasters were urgent saying, “Fulfill your work quota daily, as when there was straw!”

The sun stood still, and the moon stayed, until the nation had avenged themselves of their enemies. Isn’t this written in the book of Jashar? The sun stayed in the middle of the sky, and didn’t hurry to go down about a whole day.

Joshua said to them, “If you are a numerous people, go up to the forest, and clear land for yourself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the Rephaim; since the hill country of Ephraim is too narrow for you.”
It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge,
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit;
A faithful man is rich with blessings;
Do you see a man who is hasty in his words?
Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
As for me, I have not hurried from being a shepherd after you.

definitions.short: to press ; (by implication) to be close , hurry , withdraw
definitions.full: H213. uts [ אוּץ ] verb press, be pressed, make haste — Qal Perfect אָץ Josh 10:13 ; 17:15 ; אַ֫צְתִּי Jer 17:16 Participle אָץ Prov 19:2-3 t. Proverbs; אָצִים Exod 5:13 ; — 1 press, hasten (transitive but object not expressed) Exod 5:13 (E). 2 (intransitive) be pressed, confined, narrow Josh 17:15 הַראֶֿפְרַיִם לְךָ אָץ כִי . 3 hasten, make haste , followed by ל + Infinitive Josh 10:13 לָבוֺא אָץ לֹא (J, of sun); Prov 28:20 ׳א לְהַעֲשִׂיר ; followed by מִן Jer 17:16 א ׳לֹא מֵרֹעֶה ; followed by ב (of particular in which one hastens) Prov 19:2 ( בְּרגְלַיִם ); 29:20 ( בִּדְבָרִים ); compare also 21:5 לְמַחְסוֺר אַח וְכָלאָֿץ . Hiph`il Imperfect וַיָּאִיצוּ Gen 19:15 ; תָּאִיצוּ Isa 22:4 — hasten (transitive) followed by ב Gen 19:15 (J); followed by ל + Infinitive לְנַחֲמֵנִי ׳אַלתָּֿא Isa 22:4 . (May be Qal Imperfect, & verb י׳ע .)
